funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any stage of their career; author or editor of the proposed publication with a confirmed publisher and publication date within three years.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to publish monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles reflecting advanced research in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Flexible support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research projects in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Organisations, institutions or non‑profits; exhibition may be forthcoming or already taken place.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to produce publications related to exhibitions showcasing new research in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Organisations, institutions or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to disseminate research through live, online or hybrid events.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Organisations, institutions or nonprofit undertaking conservation research on items in public or charitable ownership.
opportunities.summary: Funding to help organisations undertake vital conservation research on items from their own collections.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Organisations, institutions or nonprofit undertaking digitisation of their own collections related to British art.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to digitise collections and make them freely available online.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage; higher tiers for postdoctoral level or equivalent experience.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for individuals to undertake research travel and/or dedicated research time in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students enrolled in or starting a master’s or doctoral degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for students to begin or continue master’s or doctoral studies in British art related fields.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered students (undergraduate level and above) from any country researching eighteenth‑ or nineteenth‑century British works on paper.
opportunities.summary: Support for students to undertake research trips to examine historical works on paper such as prints, drawings and watercolours.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer of a UK‑based master’s degree place, starting between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master’s degree that will bring new perspectives to British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: £96,000 total (£32,000 per year for three years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer of a UK‑based doctorate, starting between April 2027 and April 2028; international applicants eligible at same amount.
opportunities.summary: Full funding for a doctorate in British art, covering fees and living costs, with additional networking allowance.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: £35,000 per year for one or two years (total £35,000–£70,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral level individuals (or equivalent experience) or above.
opportunities.summary: Funding for individuals to undertake a major research project that will reshape understanding of British art.
